name: io.github.Servosity/auvik-mcp
title: Auvik MCP
description: Every Auvik endpoint as a command, plus the cross-client answers the Auvik UI and API cannot give

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: The Auvik user email whose API key you are using (Basic auth username).

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Auvik API key (Basic auth password). Auvik > Admin > Integrations > Auvik API.

environmentVariables.name: AUVIK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Auvik regional API host with no path suffix, e.g. https://auvikapi.us1.my.auvik.com
